text:
maria: Heads-up: PR #18422 is ready to land (docs + small telemetry config tweak). CI is flaking on integration job matrix-integ:3 repeatedly. Deploy freeze starts in ~2.5h. Can someone with merge perms give eyes or run a manual canary? @olivia @jonathan

devbot: CI: matrix-integ:3 — FAILED (3/3). Logs: https://ci.redwood/18422/matrix-integ:3

sam: If it's docs + a tiny config flag can we treat as low risk? I thought we had a docs-only fast-path, but config touches runtime flag so product sign-off needed. :thinking:

maria: Yeah the flag flips a telemetry toggle, default unchanged. Product approval requested. Also the integration flake looks like a timeout in db-migrate steps, probably unrelated to this PR.

jonathan: I can add my code approve. The CI flakes are from db-migrate timeouts (pod startup). We hit this elsewhere today. Not caused by the PR changes.

olivia: FYI rebase window opens at 21:00 UTC and freeze begins 22:30 UTC. If we can't get reliable green CI and product sign-off before then we should hold to avoid rush merges.

sam: Alternate plan: manual canary to the staging canary cluster and run quick smoke tests. If staging smoke passes we can merge pre-freeze with post-merge monitoring. Command I usually run:```
# local
gh pr checkout 18422
./scripts/smoke_canary.sh --env=canary
```

maria: Starting the canary run now. Will paste results in a minute.

maria: Canary smoke run output: "OK: health checks pass, basic sign-in flows exercised, telemetry toggle read as false (expected)". No obvious regressions.

jonathan: Added my approval. @pat from product can you give quick LGT M for telemetry flag?

pat: LGTM for telemetry toggle change — low risk and reversible. :+1:

devbot: NOTE: PR #18422 added to manual-merge queue by jonathan. CI still shows integ flake but canary passed.

sam: I'll stand by to monitor the canary in prod for 30m. If no regressions I can merge it before the freeze. If the db-migrate tests keep flaking we'll defer to tomorrow's rebase window.

maria: Thanks all — appreciate the quick turnaround. Tagging eng-releases for visibility. :heart:

olivia: Please update the PR description with the canary run link and product sign-off so SRE can audit the pre-freeze merge.

maria: Done — added canary logs + pat sign-off line.

sam: merging now if we stay green and post-merge rollback plan is set.

maria: on it, will monitor alerts.

sam: Merged: gh pr merge 18422 --squash — all good so far, no alerts in first 10m.

maria: Closing the loop — successful pre-freeze merge and no regressions observed in canary window. Thanks team! :tada:
